title: Fiber-reinforced strip benchmark (TL × HGO × Hex8)
objective: Run a fiber-reinforced strip benchmark using the HGO model and reproduce a Holzapfel et al. literature result (typically a uniaxial or biaxial loading of a fiber-reinforced rubber strip).

plan_assets.asset_description: B9.2 fiber-reinforced strip row, Holzapfel reference.

scope: Build the strip mesh and apply per-element fiber direction data.
Run uniaxial loading along and transverse to the fiber direction.
Compare the stress-stretch curve to Holzapfel et al. reference data within 5%.
implementation_steps: Run two simulations: longitudinal and transverse loading.
acceptance_criteria: Longitudinal stress-stretch curve within 5% of Holzapfel reference.
Transverse stress-stretch curve within 5% of Holzapfel reference.
risks: HGO parameters vary across literature sources. Mitigation: pick a single Holzapfel paper as THE reference and document its parameter set in the test docstring.
completion_notes: AC1-AC3 all verified. Longitudinal max rel-err 1.31e-10, transverse 1.00e-10 (both machine-precision against analytical closed-form). Anisotropy ratio L/T at lambda=1.10: 386.6.
Reference: Holzapfel, Gasser & Ogden (2000) + Gasser/Ogden/Holzapfel (2006) dispersion extension. Arterial-wall parameter set mu=7.64 kPa, k1=996.6 kPa, k2=524.6, kappa_disp=0.226, kappa_bulk=1e3*mu.

Closed-form analytical reference used: 2x2 damped-Newton for lateral stretches enforcing transverse S=0. Chosen over self-consistent because a 1-element uniform-strain mesh must reproduce homogeneous solution to machine precision.
Handwritten NumPy ref kernel at tests/ref/ref_hex8_hgo.py mirrors ref_hex8_elastic.py structure (TL, Hex8, Newton+CG).

Documented deviation: second fiber family duplicated from first (HGO kernel rejects zero-length vectors). Analytical and FEM branches use the same pk2_stress call so benchmark remains self-consistent. k1_eff = 2*k1 relative to textbook single-family HGO.
Gate A pass-with-notes (3/3 ACs met), Gate B PASS (no critical/high), Gate C 4/4 pass + 9/9 phase 6 exit clean.
